prompts.prompt:
Use case: pose-locked style-transfer / character reskin.
Image1 is the ORIGINAL X2 FIRST POSE, the EDIT TARGET and ABSOLUTE AUTHORITY for pose, joints, sword path, shield depth and camera. Image2 supplies Laema's APPEARANCE/MATERIAL ONLY; do NOT use its pose or weapon angle. Image3 is the original three-pose X2 flipbook, supporting motion context; render ONLY the FIRST pose.
Replace the faceless original figure with Laema WITHOUT redesigning the first pose. The previous avatar versions were wrong because the sword hand was lowered to the WAIST. In the ORIGINAL, the right sword arm crosses HIGHER across the torso: elbow near chest, wrist significantly FORWARD-RIGHT of the head/shoulder line and ABOVE the belt. Keep that original shoulder→elbow→wrist relationship exactly.
Use image1 coordinates as tracing constraints: head centre near(244,216), shoulder near(246,242), bent sword elbow near(280,245), sword wrist/guard near(306,264), pelvis near(232,304), visible blade tip near(252,314), on its512x512 reference canvas. These are approximate visual landmarks to preserve, not labels to draw. Do not lower wrist to hip, do not pull it backward near belly, do not substitute a neutral ready guard.
The sword is one straight plain silver blade running from the high forward wrist DIAGONALLY DOWN-LEFT toward the UPPER LEFT THIGH, about45deg below horizontal. Preserve the OG foreshortened visible blade length and angle. Grip→guard→blade centreline is ONE straight axis, never a crooked hidden middle. The blade does NOT dangle far down between the knees. Most readable blade length belongs in the original corridor from raised forward wrist down-left toward upper thigh. Where it crosses the far-side upper thigh, the trouser leg is in front; preserve the original occlusion instead of hiding the entire blade or laying it on top of trousers.
Shield: same physical round shield but on the FAR SIDE, partially concealed by torso and crossing arm, matching the ORIGINAL. Show a partial navy face/rim, not the full front-facing blue disc and exposed boss of the appearance image. Do not turn it into a tiny shield or strap it flat to her back.
Trace the original head direction, torso rotation, hip/knee layout and weight. Only complete the old sprite's missing lower legs/boots conservatively in the blank padding. Do not invent a deep squat, broader lunge, overhead swing or extra phase. Full figure and sword fit within the canvas.
Laema appearance: adult woman with silver-white ponytail tied red, cream rolled sleeves, blue short vest, red waist sash, brown trousers, gloves and boots, same refined shaded-volume sprite materials as image2. PLAIN steel sword and simple silver crossguard, not the appearance reference's ornate gold hilt or the rejected curved basket hilt. Navy shield with steel rim; boss occluded by pose if not visible in original.
ONE full-body sprite, square512-reference composition (larger pixel output okay), transparent alpha. No numbers, text, arrows, grid, second figure, motion effects, floor, shadows or scenery. Preserve OG pose and equipment geometry above everything else; this is a reskin of the original frame, not a revision of our rejected low-grip avatar drawing.

Edit image1's X2 opening pose, using image2 ORIGINAL POSE as geometry authority and image3 only as the example of far-side shield occlusion.
KEEP the new HIGH cross-torso right forearm and FORWARD wrist from image1. Do not lower the sword hand to the waist.
Two corrections only:
1. The sword is much too long in projection. Match the ORIGINAL foreshortened blade: guard→tip projected length about30% of her head-to-foot standing height, NOT half her body height. Keep the straight centreline diagonally DOWN-LEFT at about45degrees from that same raised forward wrist. Shorten its projected length by roughly40percent, and make it a slender plain steel blade, not a wide broadsword. Its tip ends around the UPPER THIGH / HIP LEVEL like the original, not down toward the knee. The original tip is near the belt-to-upper-thigh transition. Where the blade crosses the far-side thigh, let the brown cloth occlude it; do not draw a silver stripe over the red sash or pants. Preserve a readable straight visible segment, not a crooked point dangling between knees.
2. Tuck the round navy shield BEHIND her torso and crossing forearm like the ORIGINAL and image3. Hide most of the central face and boss behind the torso/arm; leave a partial curved navy patch/rim on the far side. Do NOT show the complete blue oval/disc with its entire rim. Same shield physical size, no miniature shield.
Keep everything else from image1: character design, face/head direction, chest/shoulder heights, crossed-arm pose, hips/knees/boots, camera and scale, white ponytail, cream sleeves, blue vest, red sash, brown clothes. Plain simple straight crossguard, no basket hilt or added equipment. Refined shaded sprite volume consistent with Laema; no extra motion phase or effects.
Output ONE full-body figure on the same square transparent canvas, with boots and sword fully inside, no text/scenery/shadows. Pose coordinates and visible sword projection must follow ORIGINAL image2; neither image1's overly long sword nor image3's low wrist is correct.
